title: Remove redundant casts (compile-gated)
summary: Removes hard casts whose operand already has exactly the target type, proved from the index's static types and written through the compile gate
intro: Read this when lint reports redundant-cast. The fix removes a cast only when the index proves the operand has the very type it is cast to; everything it cannot prove stays in the source and is listed with a named refusal. With --apply it builds the project first and after, and rolls back on any error.

help: drag-lint lint --fix --fix-rule redundant-cast --db <db> [--project <X.dproj> --apply] [--in <f.pas>] [--fix-line <L>] [--no-backup] [--rsvars <bat>] [--build-timeout <s>] [--no-compile] [--library-db <db>] [--format json]   - remove identity casts: proved from ref_types, every refusal named, --apply builds before and after and rolls back
